newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks dip on technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks dip on technical correction.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped in Friday morning trade on a technical correction, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The correction followed sharp rises early this week on foreign buying of bellweather stocks, one dealer said.
The Karachi 100-index also fell due to profit taking before the weekend, the dealer said.

The index dipped 3.40 points, or 0.19 percent, to 1,741.95 in late morning trade. There were 94 losers and 33 gainers at 11.02 a.m. (0602 GMT). Pakistan Telecommunication Company Ltd PTCA.KA fell 0.20 to 35.05.
